biggest_catch: Both bonuses depend on your referral actually earning 300 SB in their first 30 days — and the 10% is a cut of their variable earnings, not fixed income.
catches: The 300 SB bonus pays only if the referral earns 300 SB within their first 30 days; both you and the referral get 300 SB.
The 300 SB bonus is credited the day after the referral qualifies.
The 10% applies only to eligible categories (Answer, Shop, Magic Receipts, Discover, Play); signup bonuses, Swag Codes, Daily Goal bonuses, MyGiftCardsPlus bonuses, and referral bonuses are excluded.
10% continues as long as the referral stays active, with no maximum — but it is variable, never guaranteed.
The 300 SB bonus is not available in all countries.
Extra 100 SB if the referral installs SwagButton within 14 days (use your Swagbutton referral URL).
